title: Lesson 18 - Which Line Should We Take?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Excuse me, which line should we take for the City History Museum?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Take the Blue Line toward Airport.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Which platform do we need for the Blue Line?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Platform 2. The stairs are on your left, beyond the ticket machines.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Is there an elevator nearby?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Yes. It's beside the stairs and goes to the same platform.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Do we stay on the Blue Line all the way?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: No. Change at Central Station for the Green Line.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Which direction on the Green Line?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Take the train toward Hill Park and get off at Museum Square.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: How many stops is that from here?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Three stops to Central, then two more to Museum Square.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Let me make sure I've got this right. First, we take the Blue Line toward Airport for three stops.

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Then we change at Central for the Green Line toward Hill Park.

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Right. Get off at Museum Square.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Which exit should we use?

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Follow the signs for Exit C. The museum is across from the station.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: So: Blue toward Airport, change at Central, Green toward Hill Park, off at Museum Square, Exit C.

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thanks. Now the map makes sense.

lines.speaker: Station attendant
lines.text: You're welcome. Have a good visit.
